name: miditab
description: Convert MIDI files to ASCII tablature (multi-instrument) or MusicXML sheet notation.
author: Slava Kayushkin

scripts.//prepare: dist/ is gitignored but IS this package's entry point, so a consumer that links us with file: (kayushkin.com) gets nothing unless we build on install. --ignore-scripts is required, not tidiness: a bare `npm ci` here would re-trigger this same prepare, forever.
scripts.//check: The assertion the nightly repo-node-guard runs. The tests import ../dist/index.js, so they need a build first; the guard runs install -> build -> artifact -> check in that order, and `prepare` builds on install too, so dist/ is always there by the time this runs.
